<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>NDA strategy:</strong> Prime Minister Modi chaired a meeting of the National Democratic Alliance (NDA) to coordinate strategy ahead of the upcoming Lok Sabha election results.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxQd1lhSkZhakVya3dsZDdZVHlHLVp1SmY5dDF6czRxc3ZwaGtGY3UyMU1MdE5Nb3RWQlNIcW1nYkRKZ0pmM3UtMVdnYldWSHpqVDJlamJoeFgwekRXNzNzYVB1VmZGbDlPdEFKZE5tOVBxWTRZanVnTy0ta1FPdmlkaGx4YXBIWC1Ddm9iYWM2MEtyMzFuRnc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Legislative concerns:</strong> Opposition leaders have criticized the government for passing 12 bills in Parliament without debate, while the Lok Sabha saw the failure of a Constitutional Amendment Bill aimed at women’s reservation.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxPSTVKRHVGUXlhNjVqNEczYkNpd1NvbmRYOU5Fd2RIZjV3OHBob0owSzh3LVRXdUVqSDNVZTgtbVZlUG8ybS1wallfSVdTeTRtNENIU0lwV3piczdxV2NEVmE0WC1GSTQyMjR4dkNPb1pqblB2SzNHQjZBRWVXZHpPZXE2bVlQc3NGNEFJVU1NUHJMMFFqSkdRUVFFMGZNRUkzSTc0LXphM1JaLXM?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Parliamentary proceedings:</strong> The Union Budget is under discussion in Parliament, though Speaker Om Birla has suspended his attendance until the pending no-confidence motion is resolved.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Judicial intervention:</strong> Chief Justice of India Surya Kant stated that the judiciary has proactively addressed &quot;digital arrest&quot; scams rather than waiting for legislative action from Parliament.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Election administration:</strong> The Election Commission of India and State Election Commissioners concluded a National Round Table Conference in New Delhi to discuss electoral integrity and processes.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxQWHdOMzZmODdtUEdmeHRBaW9NWElLUUxuWEUyOTFsRGdnbDRTdUlMVmQxeHdIN3VGVW5md3dLcnhxYnlxdEl3QldHZXpCei1veVl5UTk5TGh5WEdXYW11Y1VQLVNFdG9ZOGp4ZkxNaXNkeW5RU2ZNbHhWNU9Cb2p0VDBfUzEzT1UyeERfRXcxNjJDRy1SZlFjVWRkemJfS0ItcElOLXhR?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxQd1lhSkZhakVya3dsZDdZVHlHLVp1SmY5dDF6czRxc3ZwaGtGY3UyMU1MdE5Nb3RWQlNIcW1nYkRKZ0pmM3UtMVdnYldWSHpqVDJlamJoeFgwekRXNzNzYVB1VmZGbDlPdEFKZE5tOVBxWTRZanVnTy0ta1FPdmlkaGx4YXBIWC1Ddm9iYWM2MEtyMzFuRnc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
